items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: “Oh that thing I did with Paul McCartney recently”

ctx.x: I mean even tonight because still I always think about Dick Hyman. Dick Hyman’s in that Charlie Parker video. You know what I mean? One of the few videos of Charlie Parker and he had the chance to sit there with Charlie Parker. Tonight I’ll be sitting with him. I mean I’m a history buff so all those things are always — you’re grateful.

I totally agree. Like Bucky. He’ll just say something in passing. “Oh that thing I did with Paul McCartney recently” or, like what? It was so much their day to day, they got on this level and it was always good.
